subject: Add volumetric atmospheric fog: introduce layered depth fog that grows denser with distance from the camera, add god rays and crepuscular light shafts if a light source is present in the scene, scatter ambient light throughout the fog volume giving it a soft internal luminosity, slightly desaturate and lighten distant objects, add a faint cool blue-grey aerial haze on the horizon. The fog should feel physically accurate and cinematic — present and atmospheric but not obscuring the subject entirely.
